ksre01.title: Aries: Any%, No Resets
ksre01.caption: Eye contact in under a second, first text in two, and then the one split no strategy can skip: waiting for the reply. Who else sprints straight into the wait?

ksre02.title: Taurus: Slow Burn%
ksre02.caption: Month four of saying nothing, one table closer at a time. Then one tiny "hi", and it turns out they'd been waiting since month one. Slow runs still finish.

ksre03.title: Gemini: The Ramble Skip
ksre03.caption: The awkward silence on a first date? Skipped. Talked through it about soup, maps and a cousin's dog. Then the date started rambling back. Who's the nervous talker in your group?

ksre04.title: Cancer: Soft-Locked on "k"
ksre04.caption: One letter, read forty-seven times, a full spiral about whether they're mad. They were driving. Tell us you've been stuck on a "k" too.

ksre05.title: Leo: The Spotlight Skip
ksre05.caption: Three skip attempts: the entrance, the ta-da, the spin. None of them worked. One question and actually listening did. Which sign needs this strat tip most?

ksre06.title: Virgo: Reset Number Forty
ksre06.caption: Forty resets on the word "hey". The forty-first went out with a typo, and the reply copied it back. Who else drafts a two-letter text like it's a speech?

ksre07.title: Libra: Stuck on the Menu Screen
ksre07.caption: Four options, eighteen minutes, one dizzy Libra. Then the date just said "the pier?" and the run was back on. Tag the friend who can never pick the restaurant.

ksre08.title: Scorpio: Playing It Cool
ksre08.caption: Checked the phone, said "cool.", faked a yawn, left first. Every cool move cost time. One honest sentence won it all back. Who in your life plays it way too cool?

ksre09.title: Sagittarius: Side Quest
ksre09.caption: Pet the dog, helped with a map, went for dumplings. Main quest abandoned. Then the last dumpling had someone else's name on it too. Best wrong turn you ever took?

ksre10.title: Capricorn: Love, Scheduled
ksre10.caption: Calendar full until next quarter, so love got pencilled in for later. Then one optional meeting got dragged off the week and Saturday opened up. Who needs to see this?

ksre11.title: Aquarius: The Friend Zone Clip
ksre11.caption: Three attempts to clip through the friend zone, three bonks. Then the best friend opened a door that was there the whole time. Ever fallen for your best friend?

ksre12.title: Pisces: Daydream%
ksre12.caption: Split one was eye contact. By split five Pisces had planned the holidays, a dog named Biscuit and growing old together. Then they said hi. Who else daydreams this fast?
